How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a USDT payment gateway is built around several key components. First, you have the payment processing engine, which handles incoming payments and verifies their authenticity. Next, you have the order management system, which stores and tracks orders in real-time. The delivery mechanism then kicks in, sending the digital product to the customer's email address. This entire process happens automatically, without any human intervention.
